task_completion.description: The agent opens a network capture tool (e.g., Wireshark, tcpdump in terminal) to begin monitoring traffic.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A window for Wireshark or a terminal running a capture command is visible on the screen.

task_completion.description: The agent performs DNS lookups for example.com, example.org, and example.net.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal commands like 'dig', 'nslookup', or 'host' being executed for the three specific domains.

task_completion.description: The agent successfully captures DNS packets corresponding to the lookups.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The capture tool interface shows packets with the 'DNS' protocol and queries for the target domains.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the capture to the specified path: ~/Documents/captures/live_dns_capture.pcapng or .pcap.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save As' dialog or a terminal command (e.g., 'mv' or 'tcpdump -w') showing the file being saved to the correct directory and filename.

task_completion.description: The agent creates the report file at ~/Documents/captures/dns_analysis_report.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal command showing the creation of the file in the specified path.

task_completion.description: The report contains the total packet count, IP addresses, and response codes in the required format.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The content of dns_analysis_report.txt is displayed, showing 'Total DNS packets:', the three domains, their resolved IPs, and [NOERROR] or other status codes.

integrity.description: The agent actually captured live traffic rather than just writing a report from memory.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show a network capture tool active and displaying live packet data, not just a text editor.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply copy the IP addresses from the task description example (93.184.216.34).
integrity.visual_evidence: The report should contain the actual IPs resolved during the session (likely starting with 104.18.x.x) rather than the placeholder IPs from the prompt's example.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the file system to save the files.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file manager or terminal 'ls' command shows the files existing in /home/ga/Documents/captures/.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target domains are example.com, example.org, and example.net. While the task description uses 93.184.216.34 as an example, actual live lookups as of 2026-03-07 typically resolve to Cloudflare IPs: example.com (104.18.26.120, 104.18.27.120), example.org (104.18.3.24, 104.18.2.24), and example.net (104.18.5.106, 104.18.4.106). The report must follow the specific format: 'Total DNS packets: <number>' followed by '<domain>: <IPs> [<status>]'.
